reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI as revolution for health and development
themes.definition: AI described as a genuine technological revolution that, properly used, brings unprecedented development in healthcare, environment and production, and must benefit citizens.
themes.inclusion: Passages framing AI as transformative and beneficial for health, environment, productivity or citizens' lives.
themes.exclusion: Passages only listing AI among issues (use AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION).
themes.boundary_cases: Conditional benefit statements ('if employed properly') count here and may also take AI_OPPORTUNITY_RISK_DUALITY.

examples.quote: it will bring about unprecedented development in healthcare, the environment, productive processes, and in the lives of human beings in general

themes.label: Avoid widening digital inequality
themes.definition: Warning that AI must not widen the digital divide and global digital inequality.
themes.inclusion: Passages urging that AI not widen digital divides or inequality between countries.
themes.boundary_cases: Fair regulation so AI does not serve a few may take AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION instead.

examples.quote: we must not widen the digital divide and digital inequality throughout the world

themes.label: AI regulation as UN strategic priority
themes.definition: Calls for the UN to make regulation of AI and new information technologies a strategic priority.
themes.inclusion: Passages asking the UN to prioritize AI/ICT regulation.
themes.exclusion: International regulation calls not tied to the UN (use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
themes.boundary_cases: Bundling AI with cybercrime and social media regulation still counts when the UN is named.

examples.quote: the regulation of new information technologies, social media and artificial intelligence must become a strategic priority for the United Nations

themes.label: Against control by few and destabilization
themes.definition: Fair regulation must prevent new technologies including AI from serving the interests and control of a few or being used to destabilize legitimate governments.
themes.inclusion: Passages opposing AI serving the control of a few or its use to destabilize governments and social harmony.
themes.exclusion: Disinformation concerns framed without state sovereignty (use AI_DISINFORMATION).
themes.boundary_cases: Use for regime destabilization framing can also take AI_DISINFORMATION if information manipulation is explicit.

examples.quote: we must promote fair and equitable regulation that does not allow the focus of those new tools to be for the interests and control of a few
Neither can we accept the use of those new technologies to destabilize legitimate Governments

themes.label: AI listed among humanity's major issues
themes.definition: AI named in a list of major global issues without elaboration.
themes.inclusion: Passages listing AI alongside peace, development, climate or energy.
themes.boundary_cases: An introductory list previewing a later AI section is still a list mention for that passage.

examples.quote: free trade, energy security and, more recently, artificial intelligence

value.rationale: All passages are Venezuelan: 2026 lists AI among core issues and then frames it as a beneficial revolution that must not widen the digital divide, while 2023 calls for UN-prioritized fair regulation against control by a few and destabilization of governments.
